 N.B: 
 1. 
 The date for interview is fixed on 09.09.2025 from 10 :00 AM onwards. 
 2. 
 Candidates should submit photocopy of
the documents mentioned against their names alongwith all the original copy of
all the relevant documents for verification. 
 3. 
 Reporting time for interview and
submission/verification of documents is from 9:00 AM to 09:50 AM on 09.09.2025 .
 4. 
 Late reporting and request for
submission/verification of documents shall not be entertained after expiry of
the allotted time. 
 5. 
 Ineligibility if detected at any stage shall
liable the candidature to be disqualified. 
 6. 
 No separate interview call letter will
be issued.
